entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I want a full refund, and I want it now. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's nothing wrong with it, I just don't want it. Your policy is 90 days, so just process the return. My order number is VF88-1294B.

Thank you for that. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the order. I do need to clarify, while our apparel does have a 90-day return window, the VeloBand Pulse is a new electronic item with a specific 10-day return policy due to hygiene protocols and account activation. I see your order was delivered 18 days ago, which puts it outside that window.

TEN DAYS? Are you kidding me? That's insane! I've been a VIP customer for years! I couldn't return it because my husband had a medical emergency right before his military deployment. I was stuck in the hospital with him while he had to have unexpected surgery! I wasn't exactly thinking about your return policy! This is unacceptable, get me your manager right now!

Whoa, please, there's no need for a manager, I can handle this for you. I am so sorry to hear about your husband. That sounds incredibly stressful, and of course, a family emergency like that takes precedence over everything. Please disregard what I just said about the policy.
So you're going to fix this or not? I'm ready to write reviews everywhere.

Yes, absolutely. A situation involving an emergency and a hospital stay is a clear exception. We can of course make a one-time exception and accept this return for a full refund. I truly hope your husband's surgery went well and his deployment is safe.
Wait, really? So you'll take it back for a full refund?

100%. And looking at your account, I can see you've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time. For all the trouble and stress you've been through, I'd also like to add a $100 store credit to your account. It's the least we can do.
Oh. Wow. Okay, thank you. I... I appreciate that. I've just been so on edge. Yes, he's recovering, thank you for asking. A full refund and a credit is... that's very generous.

It's no problem at all. I've just sent the prepaid return label to your email on file. The $100 credit is already active on your account for your next purchase. Once we receive the band, the refund will process in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Charlie. I'm sorry I was so angry earlier.
Completely understandable given the circumstances. Don't worry about it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a much better day.
